guide.tears-of-ink.toss.1: An unbreakable bond ties you to this mirror. Don't lose it, little one…
guide.tears-of-ink.toss.2: Oh, my friend! Did you lose something?…
guide.tears-of-ink.toss.3: You shouldn't throw such things around, little one…
guide.tears-of-ink.toss.4: I told you: you will need it.
guide.tears-of-ink.toss.6: No-no-no. That's not how it's done.
guide.tears-of-ink.toss.7: A contract is a contract, my friend.
guide.tears-of-ink.stash: Surely you didn't think the burden of a contract could simply be shelved?
item.tears-of-ink.ink_longknife.desc1: R — Ink Blot: a small ball of ink, slows.
message.tears-of-ink.contract_signed: The contract is signed. The ink waters call you; the dim mirror beckons you to look into it…
message.tears-of-ink.mirror_unsigned: The mirror is cloudy and cold. The letter first.
guide.tears-of-ink.mirror_vestibule: Not now, little one. The gate is right in front of you.
letter.tears-of-ink.invitation:
Most esteemed guest!

You are invited to the Ink Lands, an enchanted land full of riddles and mysteries awaiting their hero.

I have been looking for you for so long! Please sign, and the enchanted mirror will bring you to me.

With deepest respect,
Mister Guide
diary.tears-of-ink.title: The Historian's Diary
diary.tears-of-ink.empty: The pages are empty. For now.
guide.tears-of-ink.greet.1: Honored Guest! Welcome to the Vestibule — I do hope your journey was not too tiring.
guide.tears-of-ink.greet.2: The gates behind me lead to the Ink Lands. Many arrived there before you… But they did not succeed. Perhaps you will be the one to change everything?
guide.tears-of-ink.greet.3: This enchanted mirror will let you travel between worlds. Do not worry: I have made sure it will always remain with you.
guide.tears-of-ink.greet.4: Please, accept this modest gift. A shame its previous owner never had a chance to use it…
guide.tears-of-ink.greet.5: I wish you a pleasant stay. Enjoy this adventure… And do not disappoint me…
message.tears-of-ink.diary_new: A new entry seeps through the diary's pages…
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.first_steps.tex:
Here you are in the Ink Lands. Start by touching the temple basin with an empty hand. Search the chests before you take to the road. The supplies will come in handy, and then you can look for pale ore.
I'll keep track of your progress under Fate. You can hide the on-screen objectives if they get in the way.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.pale_metal.text:
Look for pale ore in the Pale Forest. Raw Pale Metal turns up in temple chests, ruins, fortifications and among the spoils of pale soldiers. Smelt it in a furnace or blast furnace.
One ingot and a crafting table will restore the Guide's gift: mend a [[restore_ram_shield|Ram Shield]] or [[restore_mercy_shield|Shield of Mercy]], or turn the Dim Scimitar into the [[restore_dim_scimitar|Wave Scimitar]].
For the [[ink_anvil|Ink Anvil]], gather five Pale Ingots, three Asphoda and one Ink. Look for Asphoda underground. Chests can contain both ingredients.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.fountain_hunt.t:
Touch the basin with an empty hand. Your first drink from each basin adds 5 to your Ink capacity, up to 200. Touch it again to set your respawn point. If you're already at the limit, a new basin can anchor you straight away and save its bonus for later.
Your Vow key points the way to another temple. Hear the Soul Trader out at the second basin you open. After that, you can summon her at any basin you've opened: sneak and right-click it. She pays Pigment for fulfilled contracts.
Build the Font on a 5×5 footprint. Lay a 3×3 floor of Scarlet Wood in the center and cover it with water. At water level, ring it with 16 blocks of Pale Wood. Stack two blocks of Scarlet Wood above each corner of the ring. Stand in the center of the water. If the Font is nearly complete, it will show you what's missing.
Hold the weapon in your main hand, sneak and right-click. Going from Dim to Contrast costs 8 Pigment and one affinity resource. Going from Contrast to Rubric costs 16 and two.
Spire: Sigil of Valor from contracts. Blood: Crimson Flower from contracts with a Blood Hunter. Ink: Mote of Soul from special orders. The pistol belongs to the Spire, the throwing dagger to Blood and the crossbow to Ink.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.intro.title: Whoever You May Be
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.intro.text: If you are reading this, then you have already met the Guide. Mister Guide, as he calls himself. There is more to that being than meets the eye — an ancient creature capable of traveling between worlds… But that is not what matters now. I once recorded the history of this world, yet since I was imprisoned in this book, my memories have become terribly distorted. Help me remember, and I will share whatever comes back to me. Trust no one — nothing here is quite what it seems… Sanguine nati, atramento mergentur.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.caterpillar.tex: Caterpillars are easy to miss when you're watching for bigger things. Yet you could tell the forests apart by them. Each has its own kind.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.caterpillar_pal: Watch your step around Tearbloom. The pale caterpillar feeds on it, and the owls feed on the caterpillar.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.caterpillar_blo: These plump caterpillars feed on blood and Fleshberries around Blood Collectors. Their raw flesh is especially nourishing when your maximum Soul is 70 or less.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.caterpillar_ink: An oily streak catches your eye and the caterpillar is already gone. These quick little creatures of the Inkwood can yield Pigment.
diary.tears-of-ink.illegible: The writing has yet to appear.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.pale_spearman.t: The spearman keeps to the shield's flank. While your eyes are on the shieldbearer, the spear is already looking for an opening. When the shieldbearer falls, the spearman breaks formation and charges.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.pale_shieldbear: The squad holds around its shieldbearer. Attack one of its crossbowmen and he'll rush to help. Put a wall in the path of his charge. The collision will give you time to strike.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.pale_crossbowma: Look behind a comrade's shield or up on a watchtower for the crossbowman. Get too close and he'll try to spring away and call for help. While his squad is intact, cover is worth more than another step toward him.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.zombie.title: Zombie
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.zombie.text: The dead man shambles on until he finds someone alive. Once I might have told you what made him rise. These days I can only advise you to keep him out of reach.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.skeleton.title: Skeleton
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.skeleton.text: The rattle of bones gives the archer away when he draws his bow. If you hear it in the dark, find cover first. It's too late to ask him where he learned to shoot.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.spider.title: Spider
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.spider.text: Spiders keep to the shade under the Crimson Sun. Look for red eyes before stepping into a dark passage. Sometimes you'll see them before you can make out the spider.
stats.tears-of-ink.title: Stats
item.tears-of-ink.fulfilled_contract.des: Give it to the Soul Trader at an ink fountain.
trader.tears-of-ink.title: Soul Trader
trader.tears-of-ink.greet: The Ink stirs, and a silhouette emerges… “You called — and here I am. As always.”
trader.tears-of-ink.need_second_fountain: The Trader will appear at your second activated fountain.
trader.tears-of-ink.intro.1: Don't be frightened, little one. I am the Soul Trader. Should you need my services, call for me at a fountain.
trader.tears-of-ink.intro.2: Hunters roam these lands. If you wish to test yourself, I can arrange for you to join one on a Hunt.
trader.tears-of-ink.intro.3: I pay in Pigment for fulfilled contracts. There are special orders, too — for Hunters who have lost their minds.
trader.tears-of-ink.intro.4: Ink can grant you great power. But remember, little one: sometimes that power costs you a piece of your own Soul.
trader.tears-of-ink.intro.complete: You can now speak to the Trader.
trader.tears-of-ink.need_drink: The fountain is silent. Drink from it first.
trader.tears-of-ink.no_room: There is not enough room by the fountain for the Ink to take shape.
trader.tears-of-ink.page: The fountain remembers everyone who drank from it. So do I. How may I serve you?
trader.tears-of-ink.option.sell: Sell a fragment of your Soul
trader.tears-of-ink.sell.text: I will take a fragment of your Soul and fill your veins with Ink. Think carefully about what you will lose:
trader.tears-of-ink.sell.none: There is nothing left for me to take.
trader.tears-of-ink.sold: The bargain is struck. Soul: %s. Ink capacity: %s.
trader.tears-of-ink.nothing_left: There is nothing left for me to take.
trader.tears-of-ink.farewell: “The fountain remembers. And so shall I.”
hunt.tears-of-ink.start: The Hunt begins! %1$s wielding %2$s stalks %3$s near %4$s. Look for the beam in the sky.
hunt.tears-of-ink.timeout: The Hunt is over: the prey dissolved into the fog.
hunt.tears-of-ink.hunter_won: %s caught the prey. The Hunt is over — no reward.
hunt.tears-of-ink.devoured: The prey has torn the hunter apart! Whoever finishes it gets a double reward.
hunt.tears-of-ink.won: The prey has fallen. Fulfilled contracts go to: %s.
hunt.tears-of-ink.won_double: The prey that devoured the hunter has fallen. Double contracts go to: %s.
hunt.tears-of-ink.your_reward: Hunt: you received a Fulfilled Contract (%s) and loot.
hunt.tears-of-ink.remote_hunter: Somewhere in the fog, %s caught the prey.
hunt.tears-of-ink.remote_prey: Somewhere in the fog, the prey tore apart the hunter (%s).
hunt.tears-of-ink.frenzy: %s turns the blade on the living!
trader.tears-of-ink.contract_weapon: This hunter left something for you: %s.
hunt.tears-of-ink.half_down: One half of the prey has fallen — one remains.
trader.tears-of-ink.board.reward.2: Reward: Pigment and the hunter weapon
trader.tears-of-ink.board.active_found: Your contract: %1$s. %2$s is there, %3$s blocks away.
trader.tears-of-ink.board.busy: Finish what you started. One contract at a time.
trader.tears-of-ink.board.no_place: The fog hides every path. Try later.
trader.tears-of-ink.board.abandoned: The contract is torn. The Fountain will remember.
hunt.tears-of-ink.contract_timeout: The contract burned out: time is up.
hunt.tears-of-ink.contract_found: You are there. %s is here — the Hunt begins!
hunt.tears-of-ink.contract_lost: %s got there first. The contract is lost.
trader.tears-of-ink.board.accepted: Agreed. %1$s is yours. Follow the mark, you have %2$s minutes.
vow.tears-of-ink.choose.title: Vow
vow.tears-of-ink.choose.text: The contract is signed, but one clause remains. Beyond the gate everyone walks their own road — and the road decides what you become. Your vow will remain with you forever.
vow.tears-of-ink.ink.name: Path of Ink
vow.tears-of-ink.ink.short: The Fountain's power in your veins.
vow.tears-of-ink.ink.text: The Fountain's Ink will take you in. Black books will open, the Ink Hearts of the fallen will answer your call. But Ink is a foreign power: the more of it in you, the less of you remains.
vow.tears-of-ink.soul.name: Path of Soul
vow.tears-of-ink.soul.short: Your own power, granted by no one.
vow.tears-of-ink.soul.text: You will walk with what is already yours. White books will open, and your Soul will awaken through your deeds. Ink Hearts will stay silent: one who chose the light cannot hear their call.
vow.tears-of-ink.book_blurred: The lines blur. This path is not for you.
vow.tears-of-ink.skill_asleep: "%s" sleeps: it belongs to another path.
vow.tears-of-ink.book_other: The lines blur. This path is not for you.
vow.tears-of-ink.awakening.contract_0: First easy contract fulfilled. Your Soul awakens: +%s.
vow.tears-of-ink.awakening.contract_1: First medium contract fulfilled. Your Soul awakens: +%s.
vow.tears-of-ink.awakening.contract_2: First hard contract fulfilled. Your Soul awakens: +%s.
vow.tears-of-ink.awakening.diary: You know this world well enough not to fear it. Soul: +%s.
vow.tears-of-ink.awakening.tempering: The shields held — and so did you. Soul: +%s.
vow.tears-of-ink.awakening.mercy: Others' wounds closed under your light. Soul: +%s.
guide.tears-of-ink.vow.chosen.ink: The Path of Ink. Bold. The Fountain will welcome you — while you still have something to give.
guide.tears-of-ink.vow.chosen.soul: The Path of Soul. A rare choice in these parts. Guard your light — it can be seen from afar.
guide.tears-of-ink.vow.gate: Not so fast. The gate will not let through one who has taken no vow.
trader.tears-of-ink.exchange.text: The Fountain loves balance. Give me some of the Ink in you — and your Soul will unfold in the space left behind.
trader.tears-of-ink.exchange.no_sold: You have already sold part of your soul. Return it first — through Atonement.
trader.tears-of-ink.exchange.no_limit: There is nothing more I can take. Your Soul will find the rest on its own.
trader.tears-of-ink.exchange.no_ink: There is too little Ink in you — I will not take the last of it.
trader.tears-of-ink.exchanged: The Ink leaves, the Soul unfolds. Soul: %s, Ink reserve: %s.
trader.tears-of-ink.unexchanged: You give back what you traded for. Not all of it returns. Soul: %s, Ink reserve: %s.
trader.tears-of-ink.sell.unexchange: Your Soul is higher than you were born with — that is my work. I will take the exchange back, but return less Ink.
item.tears-of-ink.skill_book_ink_jump.de: Ink pushes off the void itself.
item.tears-of-ink.skill_book_stride.desc: A step that cannot be stopped.
A heavy step forward: shields stay raised, enemies are pushed aside. Costs no Soul.
item.tears-of-ink.skill_book_ascension.d: The spirit is lighter than the body.
Shift + jump from the ground — your spirit lifts you high. The fall won't hurt.
vow.tears-of-ink.heart.contract_0: First easy contract fulfilled. A small Ink Heart answers: Ink reserve +%s.
vow.tears-of-ink.heart.contract_1: First medium contract fulfilled. Small Ink Heart: Ink reserve +%s.
vow.tears-of-ink.heart.contract_2: First hard contract fulfilled. Small Ink Heart: Ink reserve +%s.
vow.tears-of-ink.heart.miniboss: The guardian's Ink Heart answers your call. Ink reserve +%s — and there is less of you.
item.tears-of-ink.worn_ram_shield.desc1: A pilgrim's shield. It has seen better days.
item.tears-of-ink.worn_ram_shield.desc2: Restore at a crafting table: shield + 1 Pale Ingot.
item.tears-of-ink.worn_mercy_shield.desc: A pilgrim's shield. Light still smoulders in it.
Restore at a crafting table: shield + 1 Pale Ingot.
item.tears-of-ink.dim_scimitar.desc1: The Ink in the blade barely breathes.
item.tears-of-ink.dim_scimitar.desc2: Wave (R): weaker and costlier than a true scimitar's.
item.tears-of-ink.dim_scimitar.desc3: Restore at a crafting table: blade + 1 Pale Ingot.
guide.tears-of-ink.vow.ask: Before I hand you what is due — tell me which road you will take.
item.tears-of-ink.pale_linear_greatsword: Pale Forest · heavy two-handed sword. Wide swings and a finishing thrust.
item.tears-of-ink.blood_katar.desc1: Bloodwood · light thrusting blade. Fast thrusts with a chance to cause bleeding.
item.tears-of-ink.blood_pata.desc1: Bloodwood · medium arm-mounted blade. Thrusts and sweeping cuts.
item.tears-of-ink.blood_curved_greatswor: Bloodwood · heavy two-handed sword. Circular strikes that can cause bleeding.
item.tears-of-ink.ink_seax.desc1: Inkwood · light blade. Quick slashes that slow the target.
item.tears-of-ink.ink_falchion.desc1: Inkwood · medium blade. Fast cutting strikes and slowing effects.
item.tears-of-ink.ink_kriegsmesser.desc1: Inkwood · heavy two-handed sword. Thrusts and powerful sweeping strikes.
item.tears-of-ink.pale_misericorde.desc1: Pale Forest · a light piercing blade. A fast series of narrow thrusts.
item.tears-of-ink.pale_longsword.desc1: Pale Forest · ordinary weapon. A straight hand-and-a-half blade.
item.tears-of-ink.pale_sword.desc1: Spire · common, one-handed. Light and fast.
item.tears-of-ink.pale_greatsword.desc1: Spire · common, two-handed. Faster than other heavies.
item.tears-of-ink.blood_sword.desc1: Blood · common, one-handed. Sometimes draws blood.
item.tears-of-ink.blood_greatsword.desc1: Blood · common, two-handed. Sometimes draws blood.
item.tears-of-ink.ink_sword.desc1: Ink · common, one-handed. Hits slow the foe.
item.tears-of-ink.ink_greatsword.desc1: Ink · common, two-handed. Hits slow the foe.
gear.tears-of-ink.dull: %s is dulling — sharpen it with Pigment at an Ink Anvil.
gear.tears-of-ink.degraded: %s went dull and fell to %s. That tier's properties sleep.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.pale_ore: Found underground in the Pale Forest (Y 0–72). A stone pickaxe is enough. Drops Raw Pale Metal.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.raw_pale_metal: From Pale Ore and pale Spire soldiers. Smelt into a Pale Ingot.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.blood_ore: Found shallow under Bloodwood valleys (Y 10–60). Needs an iron pickaxe. Drops Raw Blood Metal.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.raw_blood_metal: From Blood Ore. Smelt into a Blood Ingot.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.raw_ink_metal: No ore: sometimes dropped by foes slain in the Inkwood, and found in deep ruin chests. Smelt into an Ink Ingot.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.ink_anvil: Forge local weapons, shields and armor in a 3×3 grid. Make the anvil at a crafting table from 5 Pale Ingots, 3 Asphoda and 1 Ink. Sharpen Contrast and Rubric weapons with Pigment, one per slot (a quarter of the edge each).
jei.tears-of-ink.info.pigment: The main forging currency: sharpening, ink weapons, tier ascension, changing vows. The Soul Trader pays it for Fulfilled Contracts.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.asphoda: Mined from asphodelite underground and found in ruin chests. Used for the Ink Anvil, other stations and equipment.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.blood_clot: From blood caterpillars and the Blood Collector tank. Blood weapon material.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.ink: From ink caterpillars. Spire weapon and Ink Anvil material.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.fulfilled_contract: Reward for a Hunt contract. The Soul Trader pays Pigment for it and may give the hunter's weapon.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.cursed_altar: Weapon awakenings. Place a weapon and a reagent (blood clots — Blood property, ink — Ink property), pick a slot, press Awaken. The result only sticks after Keep; Again rerolls, each costlier. A Blood Crystal or Ink Echo raises a property of its line by one level (III only this way). Slots for all weapons: Dim 1, Contrast 2, Rubric 3. Absorption can only roll and work on ordinary weapons. Foreign line works at 60%.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.madness_shard: From Ink hunters: 1–2 per contract with an Ink hunter, 2–3 for slaying one yourself. Used for the Cursed Altar.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.ink_echo: Rarely dropped by foes slain in the Inkwood. Raises an ink property by one level at the Cursed Altar.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.blood_crystal: Reward from the Trader’s special orders. At the Cursed Altar, raises a Blood awakening property by one level.
font.tears-of-ink.incomplete: The Font is incomplete: %s missing — places highlighted.
font.tears-of-ink.sigil: The Spire acknowledges your valor: Sigil of Valor.
font.tears-of-ink.sigil_progress: Points toward a Sigil of Valor: %s of %s.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.valor_sigil:
Spire — from Hunt contracts: medium 1 point, hard 2; a Sigil per 8 points. Ascends Spire weapons in the Font.

Ascension Font — a build with a 5×5 base, 4 layers: blood wood at the bottom; on it, 3×3 water in the centre, a pale ring around the water (planks, stairs, slabs — any pale wood); blood wood pillars 2 high at the ring corners. Stair facing and decorations don't matter. Stand in the centre of the water: the Font awakens (black water — Path of Ink, white — Path of Soul). Shift+Use with a weapon raises its tier: Dim → Contrast costs 8 Pigment and 1 line resource, Contrast → Rubric 16 and 2. If incomplete, it highlights what's missing.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.crimson_flower:
Blood — awarded to the owner of a completed contract with a Blood hunter: 50% for medium, guaranteed for hard. Ascends Blood weapons in the Font.

Ascension Font — a build with a 5×5 base, 4 layers: blood wood at the bottom; on it, 3×3 water in the centre, a pale ring around the water (planks, stairs, slabs — any pale wood); blood wood pillars 2 high at the ring corners. Stair facing and decorations don't matter. Stand in the centre of the water: the Font awakens (black water — Path of Ink, white — Path of Soul). Shift+Use with a weapon raises its tier: Dim → Contrast costs 8 Pigment and 1 line resource, Contrast → Rubric 16 and 2. If incomplete, it highlights what's missing.
jei.tears-of-ink.info.hope_mote:
Ink — from the Soul Trader's special orders (later). Ascends Ink weapons in the Font.

Ascension Font — a build with a 5×5 base, 4 layers: blood wood at the bottom; on it, 3×3 water in the centre, a pale ring around the water (planks, stairs, slabs — any pale wood); blood wood pillars 2 high at the ring corners. Stair facing and decorations don't matter. Stand in the centre of the water: the Font awakens (black water — Path of Ink, white — Path of Soul). Shift+Use with a weapon raises its tier: Dim → Contrast costs 8 Pigment and 1 line resource, Contrast → Rubric 16 and 2. If incomplete, it highlights what's missing.
trader.tears-of-ink.option.order: "There is a special order…" — a maddened hunter
trader.tears-of-ink.option.order_wait: No special orders yet (%s more min)
trader.tears-of-ink.option.essence: Give Essences of Soul (%s; %s → Mote of Soul)
order.tears-of-ink.taken: One of ours has lost himself. %s roams not far from here — the beam will guide you. Set him free.
order.tears-of-ink.done: %s is at peace. Take what is left of him.
order.tears-of-ink.timeout: The maddened one wandered too far. The order burned out.
order.tears-of-ink.abandoned: As you wish. Someone else, then…
jei.tears-of-ink.info.hope_essence: Reward for the Soul Trader's special order — slay a maddened hunter (Seasoned 1, Legendary 2). The Trader turns 3 essences into a Mote of Soul.
harvest.tears-of-ink.keeper_hello: Blood calls the brave. What do you seek at the Gates?
harvest.tears-of-ink.cooldown: The Gates rest. Return in %s min.
harvest.tears-of-ink.gathering: Gathering: %s of %s slots. The Gates open in %s s.
harvest.tears-of-ink.announce: The Crimson Harvest begins soon! All hunters who would test themselves and honour the tradition may take part (%s). The Ancient Gates open in %s min.

diary.tears-of-ink.entry.ink_anvil.title: [[ink_anvil|Ink Anvil]]
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.ink_anvil.text:
Forge local weapons, shields, armor and ammunition at the [[ink_anvil|Ink Anvil]]. Try a [[pale_misericorde|Pale Misericorde]] for your first piece.
The anvil also restores the sharpness of Contrast and Rubric weapons. Put the weapon in the grid and add one Pigment per slot. Each restores a quarter of its sharpness. Neglect the edge and the weapon can drop a tier.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.cursed_altar.te:
Build the [[cursed_altar|Cursed Altar]] at a crafting table. Get Shards of Madness by defeating an Ink Hunter or completing a contract with one. Blood Collectors yield Blood Clots, and Asphoda can be found underground or in ruins.
Place a weapon and a reagent on the altar, select a slot and awaken a property. Clots yield Blood properties and Ink yields Ink properties. Dim weapons have one slot, Contrast weapons two and Rubric weapons three. An attempt can yield nothing. Choose Keep if you want the result. Further attempts cost more.
Special orders can reward a Blood Crystal or Ink Echo. Put one in the catalyst slot to strengthen a property of the same affinity. Absorption is available only on common melee weapons.

diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_fog.title: Fog and Flame
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_fog.text:
In the fog it's easy to walk past a turn you know by heart. Carry a hand lantern in your off hand to clear more fog than it would from your hotbar. Lit [[ink_lantern|Ink Lanterns]] and old stone lanterns clear the fog around them. From the light you can see farther, including what's coming toward you.
Your lantern starts unlit. Right-click it with an empty hand to light it for 10 Ink. Sneak and right-click to put out your own lantern.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_soul.text:
With two shields you can take a blow and send its force back. Hold one shield in each hand. Hold right-click to raise the shields. A regular block spends Soul, but raising your guard just as a blow lands preserves it. Release your guard to unleash the force you've stored. Swapping shields loses that reserve.
A worn shield can be restored at a crafting table with one Pale Ingot. See Pale Metal for the recipes.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_ink.title: Vow of Ink: Borrowed Power
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_ink.text:
Ink returns slowly on its own. An ordinary dash is free, while special moves draw on your reserves. A clean swing with a common blade gives back a little Ink. Hunter weapons give back none.
Ink may save your life, and I'm glad you have something to defend yourself with. Just remember that the power wasn't yours to begin with.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_ruins.tex:
I know this masonry. I can almost remember what I used to call it, but the word slips away whenever I try to write it down.
Look through the ruins while you're here. Chests sometimes survive beneath fallen walls. For a fountain basin, look in the temples.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_memory.te: There's something familiar about the pale soldiers' formation. I can still picture where the next soldier will step, though I can't recall a single face beneath those helmets. I don't know why I'm so sure of those movements. The drill is all I have left, and it seems to be all they have too.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_region_pa:
The Pale Forest roads still lead to temples, and the Spire's soldiers still make their rounds at outposts and camps. Light the lanterns there for a respite before another garrison appears. Search the chests while you're there. They won't refill.
It's always day here, but there are plenty of dark places under the trees and in the caves. Bring local food. Food from your world loses 30% of its nourishment and saturation here.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_region_bl:
At the roots of Crimson Heralds, houses stand behind walls. A cross and lit lanterns mark a settlement. After a long walk, there's something strange about finding a light someone else has already lit.
The chests here can hold Blood Metal and Blood Clots. Look under the trees for Fleshberries and Blood Collectors.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_region_in: In the Inkwood, even a passing caterpillar leaves a trace of Ink. Look for Ink Metal in local chests and among the spoils of fallen enemies. Take a light before heading deeper into the forest.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_region_la: At Tar Lake you can follow the reeds along the shore. Farther out, dark water merges with the fog. Pick out a landmark while you can still see the bank.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_region_ed: The road is behind you, with bare ground and fog ahead. This is the edge of the Lands. If you've lost your bearings, the mirror can take you back to the last basin you touched.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_adit.text: If you see wooden markers in the Pale Forest, look nearby for a mine entrance. Stone stairs lit by lanterns lead down to deeper rock. Beyond the lit landing you'll have to find your own way.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_asphoda.t: Mine Asphoda from asphodelite ore with a suitable pickaxe. It also turns up in ruin chests. Set some aside for the [[ink_anvil|Ink Anvil]]. You'll need Asphoda for other stations as well.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_blood_met: Look for Blood Ore in the Bloodwood and raw metal in its settlement chests. A little also turns up in pale ruins. Smelt the metal and take the ingots to the [[ink_anvil|Ink Anvil]].
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_ink_metal: In the Inkwood, look for raw metal in chests and among the spoils of fallen enemies. There are no ore veins to mine for it. Smelt the metal for the [[ink_anvil|Ink Anvil]]. If you find an Ink Echo, save it to strengthen an awakening at the altar.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_armor.tex:
The [[ink_anvil|Ink Anvil]] lets you forge armor to suit you. Light armor takes silk thread and lets you move faster. Medium armor takes more metal and leaves your pace unchanged. Heavy armor takes Asphoda, protects you better and slows you down. You can mix pieces of different weights.
Compare the [[pale_headband|light]], [[pale_chain_hood|medium]] and [[pale_closed_helmet|heavy pale helmets]]. Armour from outside the Lands loses 60% of its armor and toughness here, so even one local piece may help.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_alchemy.t:
Make an [[alchemy_table|Alchemy Table]] and an [[empty_flask|Empty Flask]] at a crafting table. The alchemy table has three ingredient slots and one for the flask.
[[tearbloom_brew|Tearbloom Brew]] and [[strong_tearbloom_brew|Strong Tearbloom Brew]] ease the effects of a bargain with the Soul Trader for a while. The Soul you sold stays sold.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_fountain_:
Once you've opened two basins, hold the mirror in your main hand and right-click one without sneaking. Pick a basin from the list and wait for the mirror to take you there.
Away from a fountain, sneak and hold right-click with the mirror to return to the last basin you activated yourself. Travel takes 2.5 seconds to prepare, followed by a 30-second wait before you can travel again. Combat, damage or an active Hunt or order can prevent travel. The journey costs nothing.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_soul_barg:
The Soul Trader will increase your Ink capacity in exchange for part of your maximum Soul. Food and healing will help less afterwards. If you took the Soul Vow, you may lose a rank and its benefits. Your Vow still holds, and the Feats you've earned remain part of your history.
Read the terms before you agree. The Soul Trader won't sell your Soul back.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_hunt_fiel: On the Trail of a Hunt

Take a contract you can handle from the Soul Trader and make for the marked spot. The Hunter is already on the quarry's trail. Help bring it down. You'll earn a Fulfilled Contract if you contribute enough to the fight.
Take the contract back to the Soul Trader for Pigment. The contract holder earns one point of Valor for a medium Hunt and two for a hard one. Every eight points earn a Sigil of Valor. Leave fountain travel until your contract is over.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_hunter_sp: A Spire Hunter seems to measure distance with his blade. A few strikes, a step back, and then one dash puts him within reach again. Take your time when he retreats.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_hunter_bl: A Blood Hunter presses the quarry until it falters. He closes the gap quickly, working his weapon's special moves between ordinary blows. If you hunt together, leave him room to dash.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_hunter_in: An Ink Hunter would sooner rush in than let the quarry catch its breath. Keep your weapon out when it falls. Sometimes the Hunter carries on, and you're the closest thing left standing.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_mad_order:
Take a special order from the Soul Trader and follow the marker to the maddened Hunter. You have 15 minutes from accepting the order to find and defeat him. You can take another once five minutes have passed since you accepted the last one and it has ended or been abandoned.
Collect three Soul Essences from these Hunters and trade them to the Soul Trader for one Mote of Soul.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_harvest.t: A Crimson Flower is needed to ascend Blood weapons. Look for contracts with a Blood Hunter at the Soul Trader. A fulfilled medium contract has a 50% chance to award a flower, and a hard contract always awards one. The flower goes to the contract holder.
A hoot gives the owl away before its wings show through the fog. Look among the branches. While you're looking up, it may already have swooped down after a caterpillar. Sometimes a whole family keeps close by. Stay and watch if you like. The owls leave travelers alone.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_pale_stri:
Tall, armless figures emerge from the Pale Forest fog. They wander alone or together, sometimes stopping at a temple or among the trees. Then their singing carries a long way, like a prayer for those who will never come home. There is still some hope in it.
The Striders leave travelers alone. Listen if you come across them. I keep thinking I hear one voice in the whole choir.

diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_blood_col: A Blood Collector slowly pumps blood into its Reservoir. When it clots, right-click the Reservoir with an empty hand. Take the clots to a [[cursed_altar|Cursed Altar]] to awaken Blood properties.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_soul_deed:
Soul grows through Feats: take blows on your shields, master perfect blocks, defeat enemies with a shield and unleash fully charged Resonances. Reaching these milestones raises your maximum Soul.
Rank follows your maximum Soul: 115 for Steadfast, 130 for Luminous and 150 for Unbending. Steadfast lowers the Soul cost of blocking, Luminous grants more charges on a perfect block, and Unbending makes your counterstrike stronger. Selling Soul can cost you a rank, but the Feats you've earned remain part of your history.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_ink_ranks: Your stage of the Curse depends on how much Ink you can hold. At 50 you're Marked: your dash recovers sooner. At 100 you're Tainted: the dash recovers faster still, and your Ink Jump costs less. At 150 you're Hollow: a dash that saves you from an enemy's blow gives back some Ink.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_pale_deer:
Herds still roam the Pale Forest. While some deer graze, a lookout rises onto its hind legs to peer over the grass. If it calls, the whole herd answers, and the pounding of hooves soon drowns out the one that cried first.
When hunting, creep within bowshot. Once the herd bolts, it's hard to catch. A deer yields meat and a little hide.
diary.tears-of-ink.entry.draft_weaponcra:
For a new weapon, go to the [[ink_anvil|Ink Anvil]]. Pale Ingots can be forged into a [[pale_longsword|Pale Hand-and-a-Half Sword]]. A new [[ram_shield|Ram Shield]] takes Pigment. If you still have a Worn Ram Shield, [[restore_ram_shield|restore it]] with one Pale Ingot at a crafting table. A Pale Ingot will restore the [[restore_dim_scimitar|Dim Scimitar]] there too.
Forge the [[ranged_holy_pistol|Holy Pistol]], [[ranged_ink_crossbow|Ink Crossbow]] and [[ranged_blood_throwing_dagger|Blood Dagger]] at the anvil. The pistol draws charges from the bandolier, the crossbow from the quiver. Use the same grid to refill a [[ranged_holy_bandolier|Bandolier]] with [[ranged_pale_bullet|Pale Bullets]], a [[ranged_ink_quiver|Quiver]] with ordinary arrows or a dagger with Blood Ingots. An empty quiver or bandolier takes 12 arrows or bullets to refill. One ingot restores 24 dagger charges.
Weapons from outside the Lands deal 60% less damage here. A clean swing with a common local blade restores Ink. Hunter blades give back none. Blood blades can make enemies bleed, and Ink blades can slow them.

message.tears-of-ink.pantheon.greeting: Greetings, wanderer. Reaching this place is no easy feat. You must have an unusual patron. Would you care to test your strength against the sketches in my collection? I am... a collector of stories. With ink, I capture the likenesses of great warriors of the past and future. Can you earn a place on my canvas? Take this key. Right-click it in the Sanctuary tab of your personal inventory to enter or return.
